sourceOccurrences.label: Two-route weights: the low-order cases
sourceOccurrences.locator: Section 3.4, (3.14)–(3.15), printed pp.560–562; low-order cases mentioned after (3.15)
sourceOccurrences.relationship: Explicit low-order calculation from the project's eight-edge kernel; the source's all-order reduction remains separate
sourceOccurrences.note: The nine marked sums and weighted critical continuity are written out. Figures were not visually verified; no all-order moment gain is claimed.

proofUses.reason: Two routes carry separate weights; changes of variables reduce the nine marked sums to four convolution calculations.
The critical quotient bounds weighted bubbles and triangles for tau plus its finite-range convolution; the two-mark estimate supplies a summable envelope for the first two coefficients.
